body.statement:
For a foldwise coherent fit, put \(k=QU\) and \(\widehat k=\widehat Q\widehat U\), coordinatewise.  Define the analysis event
\[
 \mathcal E_{\mathrm{supp},n}=
 \left\{\operatorname*{ess\,sup}_{x,a,j:\,M_A(x)_{aj}=0}
 \widehat M_A(x)_{aj}\leq\tau_{S,n},\quad
 \operatorname*{ess\,sup}_{x,z,j:\,M_Z(x)_{zj}=0}
 \widehat M_Z(x)_{zj}\leq\tau_{S,n}\right\},
\]
where the supremum of an empty set is zero.  If \(\kappa_{\mathrm{supp},n}=o_P(1)\), then \(P(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{supp},n})\to1\).  On \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{supp},n}\),
\[
 \|E_P\widehat k\|
 \leq C_{\mathrm{reg}}\left[
 (r_A+r_Z)\|\widehat k-k\|_{L^2(P)}+r_Ar_Z
 +\ell_{A,n}+\ell_{Z,n}\right].
\]
If the two measurement supports are supplied by the observed design and imposed on the fit, the last two terms are zero.  Thus unknown-support leakage is explicit and estimable rather than silently excluded.
